name: Thread cost
description: Thread cost for the open thread: total, today's spend, model mix, session rows and costliest sub-threads. Switch between this thread alone and the full tree. The widget loads a lightweight hourly snapshot, then adds live usage as calls arrive. Available in small, medium and large. Tap to open the Token Cost dashboard.

preview.description: Optional: small, medium or large. Draws that dashboard tile box inline, for previewing sizes.
